The '''[[Forsaken]]''', known by [[Darkfriends]] as the '''Chosen''', are the highest of the [[Dark One|Dark One's]] human subordinates and are among the most feared and powerful servants of the [[Shadow]].

{{quote|The Dark One and all of the Forsaken are sealed in Shayol Ghul, sealed away by the Creator at the moment of Creation.|a well known catechism}}
